text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Minister of Commerce said a new strategy was due to support the insurance sector.
- An $8 million Islamic finance deal has been extended to the Doha-based Midmac Contracting by a syndicate of banks led by ABC Investment and Services Company.
- Oman struck a $1.4 billion deal to tap new gas fields.
- The World Bank is to lend Jordan $120 million, a World Bank official said.
- Bahrain Indian Exchange Company opened a third branch in Hamad Town in Bahrain.
